topics.name: Agentic RAG Loop
topics.description: Letting the agent decide when and what to retrieve.
notes: - 传统 RAG：每次都固定执行『检索 → 生成』。
- Agentic RAG：由模型决定是否检索、检索什么，以及结果不够时是否换一种查询再检索。
- 通常把检索器封装成工具，让 agent 在循环中按需调用。
"""Search the knowledge base for relevant passages."""
- 优点：简单问题可以跳过检索，复杂问题可以多轮检索。
- 代价：更多的模型调用，需要设置最大循环次数。

topics.name: Retrieval Grading
notes: - 检索后让模型（或规则）判断文档是否与问题相关。
- 相关：进入生成步骤；不相关：重写查询后再次检索，或回退到其他数据源。
- 用条件边根据评分结果路由，并限制重写次数，避免无限循环。
- 评分器通常使用 structured output 返回 yes/no，便于路由。

questions.title: How does agentic RAG differ from a classic fixed RAG pipeline?

options.text: The model decides whether and what to retrieve, and may retrieve several times
It requires fine-tuning the embedding model

questions.explanation: A classic pipeline always runs retrieve then generate. An agentic one lets the model control retrieval inside a loop.

questions.title: How is retrieval typically exposed to an agent in agentic RAG?

options.text: As a tool the agent can call
As part of the model weights

questions.explanation: Wrapping the retriever as a tool lets the model decide when to call it and with what query.

questions.title: Which statements describe trade-offs of agentic RAG?

options.text: It handles complex questions more flexibly
It adds model calls, so latency and cost increase
It removes the need for good indexing

questions.explanation: More autonomy brings flexibility but also cost and unpredictability. Retrieval quality still depends on indexing.

questions.title: What is the purpose of a document grading step?

options.text: To check relevance before generating, and rewrite the query or fall back if documents are not relevant

questions.explanation: Grading reduces answers built on irrelevant context.

questions.title: Fill in the method that makes the grader return a parsed GradeDocuments object.
questions.explanation: Structured output gives the router a reliable yes/no value to branch on.

questions.title: For some questions the graph never ends. What is the risk in this design?

options.text: Rewriting is not limited, so irrelevant results loop until the recursion limit
generate cannot follow a grading step

questions.explanation: Count rewrites in the state and route to a fallback or an answer such as 'I could not find it' after a few attempts.
